title: Symptom Diary Entry Freshness
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:symptom symptom_family=* symptom_epoch=* logged_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((logged_epoch-symptom_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by symptom_family
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures symptom logging lag by symptom family for symptom diaries.
value: Lag tracking shows which symptom family create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside symptom diaries.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `symptom logging lag` on `health:symptom` events and aggregate them by `symptom_family`.
visualization: Table of symptom family with average and worst symptom logging lag.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long things take for each symptom family so you can see where symptom diaries slows down.
